claude.sample_unit: prostate cancer pathology reports (unseen test set)

links.outcome: Text complexity of GPT-4 patient-centered pathology reports versus original reports
links.effect: GPT-4 significantly reduced overall text complexity (p < 0.001); below 6th-grade versions reduced academic vocabulary (mean 68.47-23.16) and simplified syntax (p = 0.0018).
links.quote: GPT-4 significantly reduced the overall text complexity of the pathology reports (p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt engineering with a validated reporting template to generate patient-centered pathology reports
